about: Control labels a page names with {{control:<id>}}. Each entry: "label" as the app shows it; "mac" names ONE place the label is checked against: {"file": "<repository path>"} (a Swift string literal in that file), {"wording": "Type.member"} (the literal of a static let or var under mac-app/QuartzTeachers), or {"say": "<contract file>#<key path>"}; "windows" is null until the Windows side fills it. "keys" holds shortcuts that are not menu items, for {{key:<id>}}: {"mac": "⇧⌘P", "windows": null, "source": "<where it is set>"}.
